targets.title: Heads I win, tails it’s chance: The illusion of control as a function of the sequence of outcomes in a purely chance task.
targets.evidence_quote: Therefore, in this study, we aimed to conceptually replicate the original study of Langer and Roth (1975) in an online context.
targets.outcome_quote: In conclusion, we were able to conceptually replicate the finding that the outcome sequence can influence the perceived task performance on guessing the outcome of a coin-toss which was defined as an ’illusion of control’ by Langer and Roth (1975).
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors explicitly conclude that they conceptually replicated the original finding. Smaller effects and inconclusive Bayesian thresholds do not override their overall verdict.
